evidence_excerpts: There is neither one universally accepted technical definition of “mindfulness” nor any broad agreement about detailed aspects of the underlying concept to which it refers.

A 5-minute meditation exercise from a popular phone application might be treated the same as a 3-month meditation retreat, and a self-report questionnaire might be equated with the characteristics of someone who has spent decades practicing.
text: The term mindfulness lacks a universally accepted technical definition and often conflates heterogeneous mental faculties, practices, interventions, and measurement targets.
